description: This file defines an interface IBasketQueryService within the ApplicationCore project that provides a method to asynchronously count total basket items for a given user.

classes.name: IBasketQueryService
classes.description: An interface providing a contract for fetching the total number of basket items for a specific user without loading data into memory.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the total count of basket items for the specified username.
